title: Animated onboarding storyboard for structured output examples & inline validator
creator: Ariadne Chen
description: Goal: design a short animated onboarding/storyboard experience and a set of visual assets for the Quickstart that teach developers how to author JSON Schema for structured output, how to use the inline validator UI in the Console, and how to choose example payloads. Deliver a small catalog of example schemas, 6 storyboard frames (mobile and desktop variants), a set of export-ready screenshots for release notes, and a short animated prototype for the docs site.
acceptance_criteria: 6 storyboard frames exported at 2x and 3x for desktop and mobile
Animated prototype (20-30s) showing author -> validate -> fix -> example execution flow
3 example schemas (simple, nested, variant types) with matching example outputs and short explainer text
Inline validator mock with 4 validation states (valid, warning, error, suggested fix) and copy approved by PM
Assets uploaded to Drive + direct Figma links, and a labeled screenshot checklist for engineering to capture Console UI screenshots
Design review completed and sign-off from Marco Alvarez (PM) and Kai Nakamura (Eng)
All assets included in release bundle for console-2026.03 and referenced in quickstart docs
progress_updates: 2026-01-28: Ticket created. Kickoff with PM Marco Alvarez. Agreed scope: animated storyboard + validator states + example catalog.

2026-02-04: Exploratory work completed. Three high-level storyboard directions sketched: (A) hands-on editor walkthrough, (B) example-first catalog browsing, (C) error-repair hero flow. Team decided to pursue hybrid of A+B.
2026-02-12: Low-fidelity frames reviewed with Kai (Eng). Eng highlighted need for showing debounce/validation latency and KV cache note in microcopy. Added a frame for 'live validation delay state'.
2026-02-20: Mid-fidelity frames delivered. PM requested stronger callouts for 'example outputs' and a quick copy change to make validation messages actionable (suggested fix text).
2026-02-28: Animated prototype (first pass) exported. Noted frame timing too slow; reduced pauses and added micro-interactions for success/failure states.
2026-03-03: Design review scheduled with cross-functional stakeholders. Preparing final screens and screenshot checklist for release engineering.
2026-03-05: Updated assets with final copy. Ready for final sign-off and production handoff on 2026-03-08.
review_feedback: Marco Alvarez (PM) 2026-02-12: Love the hybrid direction. Make example outputs more prominent and ensure copy explains tradeoffs between strict schemas and flexible parsing.
Kai Nakamura (Eng) 2026-02-12: Add a note/visual for KV cache effect on prefix validation state. Also include a grayscale variant for dark-console screenshots.
Riley Gomez (Developer Advocate) 2026-02-24: Request: include a 'copy example to code' affordance in the screenshot so users can see clipboard flow in docs.
Security Review (Security) 2026-02-25: No PII or secrets in examples; approved. Recommend adding a footnote about offline schema validation for Private deployments.
tasks: Develop mid-fidelity frames and component variants (in progress)
Produce export-ready PNGs and SVGs for docs and release notes (blocked: final copy)

decisions: Use hybrid onboarding (editor + example catalog) to lower cognitive load for first-time users
Show inline validator states adjacent to schema editor rather than in a modal to emphasize continuous feedback
Provide three canonical example schemas (Simple User, Nested Invoice, Choice/Union types) to cover common patterns
Export assets in light and dark themes; include 2x/3x sizes for retina screens
Keep microcopy neutral about implementation details (no deep runtime promises) but link to runtime docs for advanced behavior
sample_schema_examples: Nested Invoice: object with line_items (array) -> each line_item has optional discount object; demonstrates required vs optional fields
Choice/Union: response can be oneOf [SuccessSchema, ErrorSchema] with discriminator field 'status'
screenshots_requested: Schema editor with valid state and green check microcopy
Schema editor with inline error showing suggested fix collapsed and expanded
Example catalog open with 'copy example' CTA highlighted
Animated snapshot showing validation flow: edit -> validation spinner -> error toast -> quick fix applied
Light and dark theme variants for each of the above
notes_for_engineering: Validator timing: mock a 200-400ms debounce for animated prototype so it matches Console behaviour
When capturing screenshots, set locale to en-US and token-length in console to default to avoid truncation in examples
Provide placeholder endpoints in examples (api.redwood.example) and avoid including real customer data
Coordinate with ENG-2821 to include a flag that shows suggested-fix inline annotations in the Console builds used for screenshots
